research_question: What process-level latency, CPU-time, and peak-resident-memory costs accompany the five entropy architectures in the three pinned P01 implementation realizations?

execution.randomization: All 15 architecture-by-recipe cells occur once per block in a seeded random order.

primary_estimands.quantity: paired block-level median wall-time difference and ratio
primary_estimands.conditioning: nominal recipe, separately by implementation and phase

primary_estimands.quantity: paired block-level median child CPU-time difference and ratio
primary_estimands.conditioning: nominal recipe, separately by implementation and phase

primary_estimands.quantity: paired block-level median maximum resident set size difference and ratio
primary_estimands.conditioning: nominal recipe, separately by implementation and phase

secondary_estimands: cell medians and 95th percentiles for every architecture-by-recipe cell
direction consistency between primary and replay phases

metrics.wall_time_ns: monotonic parent-observed elapsed time for one isolated pair-worker process
metrics.user_cpu_ns: Linux wait4 child user CPU time
metrics.system_cpu_ns: Linux wait4 child system CPU time
metrics.max_rss_kib: Linux wait4 ru_maxrss for the isolated child process

statistical_unit: one randomized block containing one observation from every architecture-by-recipe cell

analysis.location: median of paired block-level differences and ratios
analysis.uncertainty: 95% percentile bootstrap interval over complete blocks
analysis.multiplicity_policy: Primary conclusions are descriptive cost estimates; no null-hypothesis significance declaration is made. All prespecified contrasts are reported.

failure_policy.missing_primary_observation: phase is incomplete and cannot support a primary estimate
failure_policy.unexpected_stderr_or_nonzero_exit: observation fails and the run stops

success_criteria: All 600 observations complete in each implementation-phase run.
Every worker output preserves the declared identity and honest-agreement checks where applicable.
Evidence-envelope hashes match the exact schedule, records, summary, and warmup records.
Primary and replay estimates are both reported; disagreement is retained rather than averaged away.
claim_boundaries: The measurements characterize the pinned containerized harness, not universal deployment throughput.
Process startup is intentionally included; the study does not isolate cryptographic primitive cycles.
Shared cloud placement and 0.5-vCPU scheduling can contribute noise.
A cost estimate cannot establish security superiority, exploitability, field prevalence, or a production API recommendation.
No architecture is called faster or cheaper unless the executed paired estimates support that bounded wording in both phases.
